dialog.ollama.text:
For intelligent features like automated translation suggestions and creating new language packages (Language Designer), ClioGraph utilizes the local service Ollama.

Advantages for Research:
• 100% Offline operation (no internet required)
• Maximum data privacy for confidential archival sources

If the service is not yet installed on this PC, you can download the software for free here:
https://ollama.com

Tip: After installation, start Ollama and download the base model in your Windows terminal using the command: ollama run llama3

tabs.welcome.info_text:
Welcome to ClioGraph 🏛️📊

This dynamically extensible GUI base framework serves as a highly disciplined, decoupled workspace (n-tier) for historical analysis in the Digital Humanities.

🎯 Planned Business Logic for the Full Version:

  • Source Management & Text Scanning: Automated structuring and analysis of historical documents.
  • Historical Network Analysis: High-performance relationship calculations via Kùzu-Cypher queries.
  • LLM Knowledge Graphs & GraphRAG: Local, privacy-compliant AI model training and deep prompting via Ollama.
  • Machine Learning (ML): Innovative, integrated models for automatic handwritten text recognition (HTR).

🛠️ Integrated Developer Tools:

  • System- & IDE-Designer (Sidebars): Dynamically create, move, and bilingually rename main menus, tabs, and form elements at runtime.
  • Unbreakable Code-Editor Jump: Right-click any widget to jump directly to its corresponding macro method in VS Code.

📂 Documentation Note: The project manual and system documentation (PDF & Markdown) can be found locally within the project directory at the relative path: ./_Dokumentation/

This code is provided for educational/utility purposes only without any warranty. Use at your own risk.
